login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Sign in to write in your diary.
login.forgot: Forgot your password? Use your recovery key

register.title: Create your diary
register.heading: Create your diary
register.subtitle: There is no account yet. Set your name, your email and a password to get started. As the first account you will become the administrator: only you will be able to create and delete other accounts. Your entries will be encrypted with a key derived from that password: if you forget it, they cannot be recovered without the recovery key shown next.

recovery.title: Recover access
recovery.heading: Recover access
recovery.subtitle: Enter your email, the recovery key you saved and a new password. Without the recovery key it is not possible to access your entries.
recovery.twoFactorHint: Required only when two-factor authentication is enabled on the account.

unlock.title: Unlock diary
unlock.subtitle: Your diary is locked. Enter your password to decrypt it.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.subtitle: Enter the code from your authenticator app to finish signing in. A recovery code you saved works too.
twoFactor.codesIntro: Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They are shown only once.

lock.heading: Diary locked
lock.body: There has been no activity for a while. Enter your password to keep writing.

show.recoveryIntro: It is the only copy and it will not be shown again. With it you can recover your diary if you forget your password.

admin.title: Users
admin.heading: Users
admin.subtitle: Create and delete diary accounts.
admin.recoveryTitle: Recovery key for the new user
admin.recoveryIntro: It is shown only once. Hand it to the user along with the password; with it they can recover their diary if they forget the password.
admin.confirmDelete: Delete the account for {{name}}? All their entries will be erased and cannot be recovered. This action cannot be undone.
admin.confirmTurnOffTwoFactor: Turn off two-factor authentication for {{name}}? They will only need their password to sign in.

notes.title: Notes
notes.subtitle: Notes, reminders and events. Give them a color and, if you like, attach them to a day.
notes.confirmDelete: Delete this note? This cannot be undone.

localePicker.title: Choose your language
localePicker.subtitle: Select the language you want to use.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.subtitle: Reminders and events for your diary.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.subtitle: Create and organize your timetables freely.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Personalize your diary.
settings.accountSubtitle: The email address you sign in with. Reminders are also sent there.
settings.backgroundHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP · max 2 MB
settings.backgroundTooLarge: The image exceeds the 2 MB limit.
settings.backgroundError: The image could not be read.
settings.passwordSubtitle: The diary key will be re-protected with the new password.
settings.notificationsSubtitle: Receive an email when a new reminder is created.
settings.reminderScheduleSubtitle: Choose when reminders and events announce themselves.
settings.reminderDaysBeforeHint: How many days ahead to start. The day itself is always included.
settings.reminderPreviewToday: Reminders at {{times}}, on the day itself.
settings.reminderPreview_one: Reminders at {{times}}, the day before and on the day itself.
settings.reminderPreview_other: Reminders at {{times}}, every day from {{count}} days before up to the day itself.
settings.twoFactorSubtitle: Ask for a code from your authenticator app when you sign in.
settings.twoFactorEnableHint: Turn it on and you will also need a code from an authenticator app, like Google Authenticator, Authy or 1Password, every time you sign in.
settings.twoFactorQrHint: Scan the code with your authenticator app, or enter the setup key by hand.
settings.twoFactorOnHint: A code from your authenticator app is required when you sign in.
settings.twoFactorDisableConfirm: Turn off two-factor authentication? Signing in will only require your password again.

setup.subtitle: Your diary, on your device.
setup.useOffline: Use the diary without an account
setup.offlineHint: With no account everything stays on this device: no connection, no server, no recovery.
setup.offline: The server could not be reached. Check the address and your connection.
setup.useRecoveryKey: Sign in with a recovery key
setup.twoFactorHint: This account protects sign-in with a second factor.
setup.recoverHint: Enter the recovery key shown once when the account was created.
setup.registerHint: The server has no accounts yet; this creates its first one.
setup.recoveryKeyOnce: Copy this recovery key somewhere safe now - it is shown only once and it is the only way back into the account without your password.
setup.recoveryKeySaved: I saved it - open my diary
setup.recoverTwoFactorHint: Only required if two-factor authentication is enabled on this account.

session.wrongPassword: That password does not open this diary.
session.noKeyMaterial: This device has no key material for the diary. Sign in to the server again to repair it.
session.needReconnect: The connection to the server needs to be renewed: sign in again and your local data will be kept.
session.offline: The server could not be reached.
session.offlineHint: You can unlock without a connection - your key is stored on this device.
session.localHint: This diary lives only on this device.

export.title: Export
export.hint: Your diary is written to a Markdown file and handed to the Android share sheet, so you can save it or send it wherever you like. Nothing leaves this device until you share it.

settings.local_mode: This diary lives only on this device.
settings.connect_merge_note: Sign in to sync this diary with a server. Everything already on this device is kept and merged.
settings.connect_done: This diary now syncs with your server.
settings.forget_confirm: Remove the account and its key from this device? Entries already on the server are kept.

sync.pull_confirm: Fetch new entries from the server and send the changes made on this device.
